raw_response:
Here's the automation to tag incoming emails from specific addresses as 'Internal' and then close them:

WHEN a new email arrives  
IF from email is any of ['person85@company-51.example', 'person82@company-49.example', 'person83@company-48.example', 'person84@company-50.example', 'person81@company-48.example', 'team@company-52.example']  
THEN 1. add tag "Internal"  
     2. update status to Closed

Here's the rule in JSON format:

```json
{
  "trigger": "New conversation (inbound) received",
  "conditions": [
    {
      "field": "From Email",
      "operator": "is any of",
      "values": [
        "person85@company-51.example",
        "person82@company-49.example",
        "person83@company-48.example",
        "person84@company-50.example",
        "person81@company-48.example",
        "team@company-52.example"
      ]
    }
  ],
  "logic": "null",
  "actions": [
    {
      "type": "Add Tag",
      "value": "Internal"
    },
    {
      "type": "Update Status",
      "value": "Closed"
    }
  ]
}
```

This rule applies the "Internal" tag and closes the conversation for any email received from the specified addresses. Let me know if you need any adjustments!
